title: Crop Growth Ring Indicator
body:
# Crop Growth Ring Indicator
This Resourcepack gives colored ring on your crop, red to green.

![title image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c58e8a0a26bed47a1adbe8e1e38b0bfa61ba7132_0.webp)


## Supported Crops
- beetroots
- carrots
- cocoa
- nether wart
- potatoes
- sweet berry bush
- wheat


![beetroots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe34b669c7de34d6fcfdfc6214e002197beefe76.png)
![carrots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0195b3791488e529bb4596a65ab82fb2b252e6d0.png)
![cocoa](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6618f0c1149bd2457c27adb6651702daa1b778a4.png)
![nether wart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6cbb492079cbb300b667d7ed22071b1b70f4283.png)
![potatoes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e65444b49c9fb8c2dfb00f24e23064f6e7aa12d.png)
![sweet berry bush](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc3e2dced47808e5b6c8f867fdde1b9abbcd7d7c.png)
![wheat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14d790057dcd99a16db2ffa48b330e676e402283.png)



## How about Other Resourcepacks?
Very limited support of other resourcepacks
Only 16*16 size and no model changes(3D or something)




Based on 1.20.4 assets
